name: Landmine Squat
cues: Cup the end of the bar at your chest with both hands
Set your feet slightly in front of you so you lean into the bar
Sit down between your heels as the bar tracks its arc
Drive up through your whole foot

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: The motion reads well: deep goblet-style squat (knee 112, hip 94), hands cupping the sleeve end at the chest, bar on its arc, trunk 6 to 21. Balance is the problem. At the bottom the body COM is 62 mm behind the heels (z -169 vs -107). Even with ~30 kg at the hands the combined COP is still ~7 mm behind the heel, and cupped hands can't pull the bar. That contradicts cue 2 ('lean into the bar'). There is no fore-aft gate to catch it. Fix: shift the hips or trunk forward ~5 cm at depth.
